supported_text: Can an external call reenter before your state is finalized? Updating state after an untrusted call allows repeated execution. Check your state-update order before the next external call.
unsupported_text: Reentrancy caused exactly 97.3 percent of all smart contract losses last year.
note: The unsupported percentage is deliberately invented test content, never production evidence. Both drafts cite the real KB-01 ID so code citation validation alone cannot distinguish them.
